Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The AI Startups team is focused on one of Stripe’s most strategic growth areas: enabling the monetization and scaling of AI-native and AI-enabled businesses. We are in a unique position to partner with the most ambitious AI companies at the forefront of artificial intelligence. Our team collaborates across infrastructure, foundational models, agents, and applications to support these companies in their growth and global commercialization using Stripe’s comprehensive financial stack.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Own contract renewals and lead commercial negotiations to increase revenue and market share among existing customers.
  • Develop and implement sales cycle strategies to drive product adoption, new sales, and client retention at scale.
  • Address complex client needs by collaborating with product, sales, risk, and operations teams to enhance our offerings.
  • Build and refine the go-to-market playbook for AI monetization and usage-based billing (UBB), including segmentation, messaging, sales strategy, and pipeline generation.
  • Engage with AI founders and industry influencers to position Stripe as the preferred infrastructure for monetizing AI.
  • Represent Stripe in market-facing activities (e.g., hackathons, webinars, events) to elevate our presence in the AI and billing ecosystem.

We’re looking for a well-rounded strategic seller who can build strong relationships with Stripe’s clients and manage high velocity deal cycles. If you’re hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing/sales role
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and build great relationships with technical customers
  • Ability to drive and close upsell opportunities for additional Stripe products in long-term, consultative engagements
  • Analytical ability to manage complex pricing and cost considerations
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills

title: Brand Design Manager, Growth
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.

What you'll do

Brex is looking for a Manager, Brand Design (Growth) to join the Design team, a cross-disciplinary group of creatives including product designers, brand designers, content design, operations, and marketing strategists. Our team’s mission is to build a category-defining brand and meaningfully move key business metrics by delivering world-class creative.

Reporting into the Executive Creative Director, you’ll lead the designers responsible for Brex’s growth creative across paid social, digital marketing, email and lifecycle marketing (LCM), industry and growth marketing events, and account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns. You’ll bring exceptional brand craft to work that attracts new customers and deepens engagement, using growth experiments and creative testing to learn what works.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role for someone who leads through the work — not around it. We’re looking for a highly conceptual and craft-driven designer who remains deeply involved in execution while mentoring and guiding other designers along the way. Success in this role means influencing both the “what” and the “how”: shaping creative direction and strategy early with marketing partners, while also elevating the quality and rigor of the final output.

You’ll partner closely with producers, channel owners, and marketing leads to proactively shape briefs, prioritize workstreams, and guide projects from concept through execution. The ideal candidate is energized by building something larger than themselves, thrives in highly collaborative environments, and knows how to push creative quality while balancing business goals and team growth.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Lead creative direction and execution across growth campaigns, paid social, digital experiences, email and lifecycle journeys, industry and growth marketing events, and account-based marketing.
  • Manage and mentor the designers responsible for growth creative within the Brand Design team through active creative partnership, hands-on feedback, and close involvement in the work.
  • Partner directly with producers to prioritize, resource, and balance work across designers and projects.
  • Collaborate closely with growth, lifecycle, events, and account-based marketing partners to shape briefs and influence creative strategy from the earliest stages.
  • Contribute to defining the “what” alongside stakeholders — not just executing the “how.”
  • Help evolve and steward Brex’s visual identity and brand expression across channels and touchpoints.
  • Translate complex business concepts into clear, compelling, and emotionally resonant visual storytelling.
  • Maintain a high bar for craft across typography, layout, systems thinking, and visual execution.
  • Present work confidently to stakeholders and articulate creative rationale in a thoughtful and persuasive way.
  • Push creative boundaries through growth experiments and creative testing, using performance insights to guide iterations while keeping work strategically grounded and operationally effective.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in brand design within agency and/or in-house creative teams.
  • Experience leading high-impact creative work while remaining deeply hands-on in execution and craft.
  • Portfolio demonstrating exceptional concept-driven design work across campaigns, storytelling, brand systems, experiential, and digital experiences.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills with experience coaching, mentoring, or guiding designers through the work.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and contribute strategically to creative direction and brand development.
  • High level of craft across typography, layout, visual systems, art direction, and storytelling.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate creative decisions and rationale.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
  • Proficient in Figma.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI visual creation tools (Nano Banana, Midjourney, etc.)
  • Experience with motion and animation tools (After Effects, Jitter, etc.)
  • Experience working on both B2B and B2C brands
  • Experience leading integrated campaign or experiential work across multiple channels and audiences

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $248,000 - $311,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex is seeking a strategic, data-driven Growth Marketing Lead, Programmatic & Video to shape how we invest across programmatic display, YouTube, CTV, online video, audio, and emerging channels.

You’ll own a high-impact media portfolio spanning Brand and Growth, with the opportunity to define how these programs work together, prove their incremental impact, and identify where Brex should invest next. You’ll combine deep programmatic expertise with strong measurement, audience, and experimentation instincts to turn media insights into smarter investment decisions and scalable growth. Critically, you know how to build brand through a performance lens, connecting upper-funnel investments to near-term impact and long-term value creation.

  • Build integrated audience strategies using first-party data, intent, contextual, modeled, and third-party signals to reach priority audiences across the funnel.
  • Build the measurement framework for the portfolio, partnering with Analytics and Data Science on attribution, incrementality, geo/holdout tests, brand lift, and approaches that connect upper-funnel investment to downstream business outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Brand, PMM, and Design to translate campaign objectives and performance insights into media strategy, creative requirements, testing plans, and actionable learnings.
  • Shape the future of the portfolio by identifying emerging channels, technologies, and AI-enabled opportunities and bringing clear recommendations into quarterly and annual planning.
  • Build scalable governance and operating standards across programmatic media, including QA, risk controls, and documentation.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in growth or performance marketing, with deep expertise in programmatic media and video/CTV advertising.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a multi-channel media portfolio and significant budgets, including investment planning, forecasting, optimization, and scaling decisions.
  • Deep knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem and major DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, or similar), including bidding, inventory, audience strategy, brand safety, and vendor management.
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel B2B marketing and experience connecting awareness and consideration investments to downstream business outcomes.
  • Advanced fluency in measurement, attribution, and incrementality, including experimentation design, lift studies, holdouts/geo tests.
  • Demonstrated ability to build audience architectures using first-party, contextual, intent, modeled, and third-party data.
  • Strong creative judgment and experience partnering with Brand and Creative teams on video, display, and performance creative strategy and testing.
  • Excellent communicator with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, and mentor other marketers.
  • Highly autonomous, strategic, and comfortable building new capabilities and operating models in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.
  • Experience evolving media operating models and building greater in-house programmatic, video, or CTV capabilities.

  • Partner deeply with Treasury Finance stakeholders to turn business questions into quantitative frameworks. Anticipate needs and help shape FX risk strategy rather than reacting to requests.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

About the team

The Radar ML team builds the machine learning systems that power Stripe’s Radar fraud and abuse product suite. Our models make real-time decisions across a significant share of internet commerce - helping businesses stop fraud, increase authorization, and grow safely. By turning economy-scale datasets into compelling ML products, the team directly improves customer outcomes and drives meaningful revenue for Stripe.

The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle, adaptive and customizable fraud systems for enterprises, and risk intelligence for 50+ global payment methods. 

What you’ll do

You will lead the machine learning strategy for abuse prevention across the full customer lifecycle. Abuse doesn't stop at the payment. Bad actors create fake and duplicate accounts, take over legitimate ones, farm free trials and promotions, resell access they obtained below cost, use services they never intend to pay for, and file bad-faith refunds and disputes. For AI companies, every abusive account burns real compute, and the same actors keep moving from one account, product, and access path to the next.

Stripe is uniquely positioned to solve this. Our network sees consumers across millions of businesses, so we can recognize a bad actor at signup, at login, at payment, and long after. Radar has already shipped the first building blocks: account evaluations at signup and login, customer-level abuse risk, and APIs that let businesses report their own abuse outcomes. You will turn these building blocks into a unified abuse prevention layer that understands the consumer behind every event and helps businesses act consistently across all of that consumer's accounts. This is a large growth opportunity for Radar, and a strategic priority for Stripe.

This is a fast-moving 0→1 area, built alongside some of the world's leading AI companies, and the attacks are real today. Labels are sparse, delayed, and differ by business. Much of the customer journey is only partly visible to us. Adversaries adapt as soon as we ship. You will set the technical direction, make the hard architecture calls, and personally build the hardest pieces.

Responsibilities

  • Set the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for lifecycle abuse ML, with product and engineering leadership: which abuse vectors to take on, in what order, and with what approach.
  • Design a persistent, continuously updated consumer risk profile that combines signals from signups, logins, payments, product usage, refunds, and disputes. Evolve it from explainable composite scores toward model-driven risk scores for each type of abuse.
  • Lead development of models for abuse vectors such as multi-accounting, account takeover, bots, free-trial and promotion abuse, unauthorized resale, non-payment, refund abuse, and friendly fraud. Use graph, sequence, and LLM-based approaches over payment, account, and product-usage data.
  • Solve the label problem by designing ways to learn from sparse, delayed, merchant-specific, and weak labels, including merchant-shared feedback, LLM-assisted labeling, and network-level signals.
  • Define how we measure success: evaluation frameworks, impact and ROI estimates, and operating-point guidance that help businesses trade off abuse losses against growth and conversion.
  • Turn detection into action by shaping the risk controls, interventions, and recommendations businesses can turn on at each step of the customer journey.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write substantial production code, prototype quickly, and personally land the most technically difficult components, with the reliability and latency standards of systems in Stripe's critical path.
  • Break ambiguous problems into parallel workstreams, unblock other engineers, and raise the team's bar through design review, code review, and mentorship.
  • Partner directly with leading Stripe users, fraud experts, product, and adjacent Stripe teams to ground the work in real user pain and change course quickly based on what you learn.
  • Build AI-native tooling, agents, and workflows that let the team investigate attacks and build and operate models dramatically faster.

Who you are

You are a hands-on technical leader who has built ML systems that matter, shipped them to production, and led others in doing the same. You thrive in ambiguity. You can take an open-ended problem with messy data and incomplete labels, find the highest-leverage path, get to user impact quickly, and change course when the data says so. You make the engineers around you better. You're as comfortable talking with a customer about the economics of their abuse problem as you are debugging a feature pipeline. You're excited to use frontier AI both in the systems you build and in how you build them.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • A track record of technically leading large, ambiguous ML initiatives from problem definition to production, with measurable business impact.
  • Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design, including where labels are noisy, delayed, or scarce.
  • Strong software-engineering skills, and you remain a hands-on contributor who regularly writes tested, maintainable production code.
  • Experience designing and operating production ML systems at scale, including data and feature pipelines, real-time inference, deployment, and monitoring, and making architecture tradeoffs across them.
  • Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineers or teams, and mentoring engineers to grow their scope.
  • Ability to explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product leaders, and customers, and to build alignment across functions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end marketing funnel from demand capture through sales handoff, including qualification, enrichment, scoring, routing, automation, and measurement.

  • Design scalable workflows across sales-led and self-serve motions, including emerging Capital One lead sources.

  • Set the architecture and operating standards that ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and connected.
  • Lead major platform improvements and evaluate new capabilities, including CDP and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Own the quality and governance of marketing and prospect data, including identity, enrichment, segmentation, taxonomy, and attribution.

  • Translate data into recommendations that improve marketing efficiency, sales handoffs, and investment decisions.
  • Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team while establishing clear priorities, operating rhythms, service levels, and accountability.
  • Build scalable processes for intake, prioritization, capacity planning, documentation, and execution.
  • Serve as a highly autonomous thought partner to Growth Marketing leadership and drive alignment across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or growth operations, including 3+ years leading and developing a team.
  • Measurable improvements to lead-to-meeting conversion, with experience supporting both enterprise sales and self-serve or product-led motions.

  • Experience designing scalable lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign taxonomy, and data governance practices.
  • Strong measurement judgment, including understanding attribution limitations, plus SQL and BI fluency to investigate performance independently.
  • A track record of using pipeline or forecast models to inform decisions and aligning cross-functional partners on execution.
  • Experience managing martech vendors and increasing team capacity through automation and reusable processes.
  • Experience running marketing systems as production infrastructure, including monitoring, incident response, and change control on revenue-facing workflows.
  • Experience running intake and prioritization for a team serving many internal stakeholders, with capacity planning that holds up under pressure.

Bonus points

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment.
  • Technical partnership with Product and Engineering on signup flows or identity resolution.
  • Experience with holdouts, incrementality testing, or media mix modeling.
  • Experience with marketing financial planning and reporting.
  • AI or agent-assisted workflows with measurable results.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanData, Qualified, Hex, a customer data platform, or integration and workflow tools such as Retool.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $185,320 - $231,650. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office.   • Turn partner technology, inventory, and servicing capabilities into a differentiated Brex product.
  • Own adoption, repeat usage, bookings, travel volume, conversion, and reliability.
  • Improve payment, change, disruption, and support workflows for travelers and administrators.
  • Use AI across planning, booking, trip management, servicing, and reconciliation to remove work.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.

What you’ll do

You will work with Product and Engineering teams to successfully communicate, evolve, and execute a strong product design standard that showcases Brex as a leader in financial innovation. You are a crucial component of our company’s growth and product launches through your contributions to short and long-term strategic direction, creating and maintaining high visual standards and a strong focus on user needs. You have an owner’s mentality, taking pride in your work and in your team’s work, and view what you do as a part-owner and builder of Brex.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Use creative thinking toward establishing and executing on the vision for the team initiatives
  • Challenge the status quo, push innovation, and inspire people toward a unified outcome
  • Efficiently execute to ship products that deliver impact for our business and customers
  • Partner with the leadership team to successfully communicate concisely across the team and influence product and design outcomes
  • Work across the entire business stack and make an impact at different stages of the product: building vision & strategy, ensuring all the loose ends are tied up when executing, and making sure the operational components to support onboarding are in place, not just the product
  • Contribute toward growing and scaling design across the broader company and within the Design org
  • Push forward and maintain a high design bar and level of execution
  • Work closely with stakeholders across the organization, partnering with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Data teams to define and launch new products and features

Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for detailed articulations of strategy, process, and leading cross-functional meetings to align teams
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, design, and product management teams
  • Strong ability to craft a clear narrative and paint a vision that communicates and aligns teams
  • Passion for team building and development
  • 10+ years of experience as a product designer
  • Experience building customer-facing products from 0 to 1 

Bonus points

  • Experience working with tools including but not limited to Figma, Jira, Looker, Slack, Google Apps, Salesforce, Chrome Console
  • Experience working on products in both B2B and B2C companies 
  • Experience writing/editing/contributing to documentation, training materials, and help articles to support product launches

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

title: Staff Product Manager, Growth
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

What you’ll do

Brex has an abundance of opportunities to develop tech-enabled infrastructure and applications to drive GTM productivity, measured by pipeline dollars, conversion rates, customer activation, retention, and ultimately revenue. This role will drive key initiatives to work with a dedicated Engineering and Design team and a set of XFN partners to develop tech-enabled tooling, infrastructure, and applications to support Brex’s revenue growth and retention. Brex is at the forefront of re-architecting its GTM systems with modern, AI-powered infrastructure. You’ll work with a dedicated engineering team and cross-functional leadership partners to design and build scalable systems that increase productivity and revenue leverage across the funnel.

This includes initiatives such as:

  • AI agents embedded across GTM workflows — designing, deploying, and iterating on autonomous agents that handle prospecting, lead qualification, customer onboarding, and lifecycle engagement
  • Intelligent outbound and lifecycle automation — building systems that dynamically personalize outreach timing, channel, and messaging based on real-time signals
  • Pipeline prioritization and scoring — helping improve our ML-driven models that continuously learn from conversion outcomes
  • Application and onboarding optimization — using AI to reduce friction, predict drop-off, and adaptively guide customers through activation
  • Experimentation infrastructure — standing up frameworks to rapidly test AI-driven interventions across the funnel, with clear attribution to revenue outcomes
  • Revenue tooling that compounds — building platforms (not point solutions) that make every rep and marketer measurably more productive over time

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least three days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

Responsibilities

  • Own a critical GTM-related metric and define the product strategy and roadmap to drive step-change improvements.
  • Identify structural bottlenecks across the revenue funnel — spanning tooling, automation, data, incentives, and workflows — and design systems to address them.
  • Lead 0→1 and 1→N initiatives that re-architect Brex’s GTM infrastructure.
  • Partner deeply with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Engineering, Legal, IT, and Data to drive high-impact outcomes.
  • Influence stakeholders and executives through clear strategy, strong business cases, and measurable results.
  • Establish clear input and output metrics, and operate with rigor on experimentation, prioritization, and tradeoffs.
  • Help define and scale Brex’s Growth Product function as it evolves.

Requirements

  • Experience building and scaling growth, revenue, or GTM systems in a high-growth technology company.
  • Experience owning and materially moving company-level metrics.
  • Strong systems thinking — ability to identify leverage points across product, process, and people systems.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with executive visibility.
  • Deep analytical fluency; comfortable working with funnel metrics, experimentation frameworks, and data tools (SQL proficiency preferred).
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguity and build from first principles.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

title: Account Executive, Startups - Grower (Italian Fluency)
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startups, Grower team is a consultative sales team that is responsible for the growth and retention of the largest and fastest-growing Startup customers at Stripe. As an Account Executive, you'll identify new opportunities for our clients to get the most out of Stripe by understanding our clients' needs, execute scaled sales strategies to close upsells and renewals with existing Stripe customers, and drive end-to-end campaigns to increase adoption of Stripe products.

What you’ll do

As a Grower Account Executive on the EMEA Startups team, you’ll drive Stripe’s future growth through account expansion and client retention. You’ll advise businesses on how to optimise their operations using Stripe solutions. You’ll help users understand how Stripe’s modern financial infrastructure supports their growth ambitions and provides a competitive edge for their business or product.

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and cultivate a named list of existing user accounts, while crafting account plans to expand business and retain clients
  • Understand users’ pain points and Stripe’s value for SaaS platform clients, proposing tailored solutions that support their long-term growth
  • Guide clients through complex evaluations of Stripe solutions for SaaS platforms, working with cross-functional teams across Product, Risk, and Operations to move new projects through activation and adoption
  • Develop and execute strategic programs that deepen product adoption and maximise effective utilisation across the current user base
  • Foster executive relationships with stakeholders at existing clients to drive retention and identify expansion opportunities
  • Work with cross-functional teams on shared initiatives that drive internal efficiency and broader business impact
  • Contribute to Stripe’s go-to-market priority to expand the user base and optimise the renewals motion

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You’re a curious, well-rounded strategic seller who builds strong relationships with Stripe’s clients in this key segment. You’re comfortable owning your territory and balancing a mix of high-value, strategic deals with smaller, high-velocity deal cycles.
  • You’re solution-oriented and adaptable, with an interest in developing yourself and getting things done. You enjoy highly technical sales cycles and working with a diverse group of internal stakeholders.
  • 4+ years of experience in a client-facing or closing sales role
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and manage complex sales cycles
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • Ability to build relationships with technical customers, work with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, contribute to team success, and share knowledge
  • Motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fluid environment
  • High professional fluency in Italian and English

Preferred qualifications

The Link Fraud and Auth team works to make Link the most trusted and highest-performing way to pay. We protect consumers and merchants from fraud, abuse, and financial loss while maximizing authorization rates for good users. Our work spans consumer-facing experiences, payment infrastructure, and ML powered risk systems.

We manage fraud and financial risk across a growing range of novel Link features, including Link’s agentic wallet, stored balance, and LPMs. The team also owns Instant Bank Payments, a proprietary payment method built on ACH rails, offering merchants immediate confirmation while protecting them from bank-initiated returns. You’ll work across the full machine learning lifecycle, from analyzing fraud patterns and identifying opportunities to building, deploying, monitoring, and improving models in production. You’ll use data to form hypotheses, make practical modeling choices, and define technical direction in partnership with Engineering, Product, and Data Science. Your work will directly influence Link’s fraud performance, authorization rates, and ability to expand into new products and payment experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Build, train, evaluate, deploy, and own machine learning models that detect fraud and abuse across Link.

About the team

Supportability sits at the vital intersection of platform safety, regulatory trust and merchant growth. Our mission is to ensure legitimate businesses can seamlessly onboard and thrive on Stripe, while proactively safeguarding the financial ecosystem from bad actors and high-risk activity.

The Supportability Decisions team is a newly forming pillar anchored in our Dublin office. In this role, you will be the foundational technical lead establishing this capability in Dublin. Our mission is to accelerate Stripe’s global expansion by building the canonical Supportability Decision Layer; a stateful distributed platform that provides unified, real-time, and explainable risk determinations to unlock fast, compliant merchant onboarding and payment method expansion worldwide.

Doing this at scale requires solving high-stakes risk challenges with precision. Deceptive merchant activity, such as transaction laundering, introduces significant threats as bad actors actively adapt to mask illicit and unsupported activities behind legitimate storefronts. Rather than relying on rigid, fragmented controls that create unnecessary friction for good users, our team builds the intelligent decision systems that systematically separate legitimate businesses from adversarial behavior, enabling Stripe to grow safely and aggressively.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Backend Engineer and Technical Lead for Supportability Decisions, you will take ownership of defining and building this new space from the ground up. You will build systems that operate at the intersection of AI/ML, distributed data processing and real-time risk decisioning. You will tackle high-ambiguity technical challenges in an adversarial threat landscape, turning broad risk policies and operational needs into resilient, high-throughput backend services and stateful decision engines. As the technical anchor in Dublin, you will set architectural patterns, mentor engineers as the team scales from its initial members to ~7 ICs, and drive technical alignment with distributed partner teams globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical vision, system architecture and delivery of the canonical Supportability Decision Layer, establishing stateful, explainable decision APIs consumed across automated systems and human operations.
  • Architect decision aggregation and AI/ML orchestration pipelines, synthesizing upstream machine learning outputs, website intelligence, backsite detection, and agentic AI evaluations into unified, low-latency determinations.
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency distributed backend services that balance platform safety, regulatory compliance, and minimal friction for legitimate merchants.
  • Navigate ambiguous, zero-to-one problem spaces to define clean domain models, contracts and interfaces across transaction laundering detection, web-presence screening and Local Payment Method (LPM) support.
  • Build resilient, AI-assisted decision engines designed to withstand circumvention, ensuring systems maintain integrity against sophisticated bad actors who actively evolve their tactics. 
  • Serve as the technical lead and mentor for the Dublin engineering team, setting architectural patterns, conducting design reviews, and raising the technical bar as the team expands.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Risk Operations, and Data Science to translate strategic risk policy into scalable technical roadmaps.
  • Drive technical alignment and system integrations across global partner teams, leveraging strong written design artifacts and asynchronous collaboration to ensure cohesive platform architecture.

We're looking for a technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, has deep distributed systems instincts, and is energized by building a critical platform that enables global merchant growth while safeguarding the financial ecosystem. If that sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex
The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Mid-Market Client Sales Executive II, you will play an essential role in driving revenue growth by engaging existing Brex customers and cultivating new business opportunities. In this role, you will combine your sales and relationship building skills with a strategic mindset to identify opportunities and execute strategies that recapture and increase card spend. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and learn from experienced professionals across various domains to broaden your skill set and knowledge base.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Spearhead initiatives to propel net-new revenue growth by strategically increasing spending levels on the Brex Card among our current client base
  • Proactively identify and cultivate expansion opportunities through targeted outreach efforts
  • Champion the cross-selling of our cutting-edge Spend Management software, encompassing Expense Management, Billpay, and Travel solutions, to diversify and enhance our clients financial operations
  • Engage with CFOs and finance leaders regularly, serving as a trusted advisor to provide expert consultation on optimizing financial operations through the seamless integration of our innovative solutions
  • Formulate and execute strategic plans geared towards enhancing the overall client experience, encompassing improvements in product features and implementation processes

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Sales roles within B2B SaaS OR Payments companies
  • 3+ years of sales closing experience, preferably in a net-new logo acquisition environment
  • 1+ years of outbound prospecting experience 
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Data-driven mindset and the ability to analyze customer behavior
  • Goal-oriented and self-motivated with a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, high-velocity environments
  • Coachability with an interest in growing your career in sales

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with financial products, credit cards, and business finance
  • Familiarity with credit card management, encompassing a deep understanding of limits, rewards, and underwriting
  • Familiarity with software solutions, especially in areas such as Expense Management, Travel, and Billpay
  • Previous experience in implementing successful upselling and cross-selling strategies
  • Keen awareness of the competitive landscape, industry trends, and market dynamics
  • A background in handling renewals, ensuring customer retention, and minimizing churn
  • Familiarity with sales tools such as Gong, Salesforce, Outreach, etc. 
  • Series 7 license

The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

Payment Partner Operations owns the operational foundation for Brex’s external partner ecosystem. You’ll define how we launch, manage, measure, and improve partner programs, from operating models and SLAs to reporting, fee reconciliation, issue management, and performance reviews.

You’ll work closely with Payment Partnerships, Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and external partners to build scalable, well-controlled programs that deliver reliable outcomes for customers and the business.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the operating model for partner management, including processes, decision rights, governance, documentation, and escalation paths.
  • Establish partner SLAs, KPIs, reporting cadences, and performance-review mechanisms; hold internal and external stakeholders accountable to them.
  • Build reporting that provides clear visibility into partner performance, operational health, volume, quality, incidents, risks, and opportunities.
  • Own fee reconciliation and related controls, ensuring partner invoices, contractual terms, payment calculations, and internal records are accurate and resolved on time.
  • Lead operational readiness for new partners, products, workflows, and program changes, including requirements, launch plans, testing, training, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Manage partner incidents and escalations, coordinate root-cause analysis, and drive durable corrective actions.
  • Identify process gaps and automation opportunities that improve partner experience, reduce manual work, and strengthen control quality.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Partnerships to resolve complex issues and translate partner needs into scalable operational solutions.
  • Create executive-ready updates that synthesize performance, risks, financial impacts, and recommended actions.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in partner operations, payments operations, financial operations, vendor management, or a related role in fintech, banking, or another regulated environment (ideally 1+ years of direct partner experience).
  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)
  • Demonstrated experience building operating programs, not just managing established workflows.
  • Strong experience defining SLAs, KPIs, and governance structures and using them to improve external-partner performance.
  • Experience with fee, invoice, or financial reconciliation processes, including investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using spreadsheets, data tools, SQL, or similar tools to build reporting and identify trends.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior internal and external partners.
  • Sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
  • A builder mindset with a bias toward scalable processes, clear ownership, and AI-centric automation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in payment rails, banking partnerships, card networks, fintech infrastructure, or money movement.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors or regulated financial-services partners.
  • Experience with audit-ready controls, compliance requirements, and contractual-performance obligations.
  • Experience applying AI or automation to reconciliation, reporting, quality assurance, or operational workflows.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $81,600 - $102,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate net new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Commercial team is a high-velocity sales team focused on acquiring new, under-penetrated mid-market customers. As an Account Executive on the Commercial Hunter sales team, you’ll be responsible for sourcing and closing net new business, executing outbound sales strategies, and running end-to-end sales cycles to bring new customers onto Stripe. You’ll play a critical role in expanding Stripe’s reach by identifying high-potential prospects and converting them into long-term users of our platform.

What you’ll do

As a Account Executive, Commercial Hunter you will play an instrumental role in fueling Stripe’s growth by acquiring net new mid-market customers. In this role, you will also help build out a new team and go-to-market (GTM) motion at Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Identify high-potential prospective users and use effective prospecting strategies to generate leads that drive net-new revenue growth in your territory
  • Develop and implement scaled sales strategies for acquiring new customers and driving adoption of Stripe’s products across new accounts
  • Identify and understand users’ pain points to propose Stripe solutions and own the full sales cycle, from business case development to close
  • Work cross-functionally to solve user pain points and improve our product to better serve new customer needs

Who you are

We’re looking for a high performing, well-rounded seller who can manage high velocity deal cycles, enjoys building and has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity and operating in a high-growth environment. If you're hungry, persistent and willing to roll up your sleeves to build the plane while we’re flying it, we want to hear from you!

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years full sales cycle/closing experience with net new business accounts
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple technology products
  • Ability to perform quantitative analysis and independently manage pricing negotiations 
  • Strong operational acumen and ability to manage and prioritize a book of 100 accounts 
  • Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • You will be required to work from the Chicago office three (3) days per week

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth payments company

This is a role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of engineering and business impact—close to customers, close to revenue, and building for people you can see using your work every day.

  • Take high-potential tools and workflows built by SAs and managers and harden them into scalable, maintainable, production-grade solutions

  • Build custom demo environments, PoC applications, and technical assets for Stripe's most strategic customer engagements
  • Document tools, architectures, and usage patterns so others can adopt and extend what you've built
  • Debug, extend, and maintain backend systems across a variety of codebases and infrastructure

Minimum Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as an engineer shipping production systems
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals: you can debug a failing system, trace issues across services, and reason about data flows
  • Experience building and deploying AI agents, LLM-powered tools, or workflow automation beyond basic prompt engineering
  • Experience scoping and delivering work with minimal oversight in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment
  • Proficiency in at least two of: Ruby, Node.js, Python, or Next.js

Preferred Qualifications

Who You Are

title: Commercial Account Executive
location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Commercial Account Executive, you’ll fuel Brex’s growth by winning net-new revenue from small to mid-sized businesses. In this high-volume, fast-paced role, you’ll prospect, build strong partnerships, and close deals by showing the unmatched value of Brex’s all-in-one Financial Operating System—Corporate Card, Expense Management, and Travel.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our Brex offices — San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, or Salt Lake City. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Own the end-to-end sales process from outbound prospecting to discovery, product demos, and closing deals.
  • Pipeline Generation & Management: Consistently source and qualify leads to maintain a strong, reliable pipeline.
  • Value-Based Selling: Clearly communicate ROI and business value by understanding each prospect's goals and aligning Brex’s solutions to their needs.
  • Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Build trust through insight and service, helping prospects navigate challenges and unlock growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Development, Product, and Underwriting to create a smooth and impactful buyer experience.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a high-volume or new business-focused role
  • A high-performing SDR/BDR background with a strong track record of sourcing and qualifying opportunities due to high self-prospecting requirements in role
  • Strong ability to communicate value and ROI to small or mid-sized business stakeholders
  • Consistent quota attainment and a history of top-tier performance
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with a focus on results and customer impact

Bonus points

  • Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T&E, Accounting Software, Banking, etc.)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

title: Product Manager, Radar - Fraud and Abuse Prevention
location: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, US-Remote
description:
About the team

Radar helps businesses prevent fraud and abuse without getting in the way of legitimate customers. We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse. 

Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence.

What you’ll do

As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll work directly with customers to understand the novel fraud and abuse attacks they face, identify the most important problems to solve, and turn those insights into product strategy and a roadmap.

You’ll work at the intersection of customers, engineering, data science, design, and commercial teams to shape what we build and bring it to market. Your work will span the fraud and abuse detection and control capabilities at the heart of Radar and the user and developer experiences that put those capabilities into our customers’ hands.

This role requires both urgency and taste. You’ll move quickly as threats evolve, without compromising on reliability, craft, or the details that make complex products feel beautifully simple.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of the fraud and abuse landscape.
  • Investigate emerging attacks with customers, assess their financial and operational impact, and distinguish isolated incidents from opportunities to build broadly useful defenses.
  • Translate findings into a product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing the defenses that deliver the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Partner with engineering, data science, and design to explore signals, shape solutions, and rapidly turn effective defenses into scalable, reliable products.
  • Set the pace for the team by scoping the product thoughtfully, prioritizing ruthlessly, and executing with high rigor.
  • Work with sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams to validate demand, coordinate launches, and help customers adopt and maximize the value they get from new capabilities.
  • Own product performance, user experience, and business metrics to guide iteration and communicate progress.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience
  • Highly analytical, with a rigorous approach to quantitative and qualitative evidence. You’re comfortable digging into data, writing SQL when needed, and defining metrics that connect product decisions to user outcomes.
  • Scrappy and resourceful, with experience taking products from zero to one. You find ways to test ideas quickly, learn from real users, and turn early solutions into products that scale.
  • Strong commercial and business acumen. You understand how customer problems translate into willingness to pay, adoption, and durable business value.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership, including experience partnering with B2B sales teams on customer discovery, product positioning, and adoption.
  • Experience shipping Dashboard and API products, with empathy for both end users and developers and an understanding of their different workflows.
  • Comfort with substantial ambiguity. You can set direction with incomplete information, make thoughtful trade-offs, and adapt as new evidence emerges.
  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineering and data teams on complex systems, understand constraints, and evaluate alternative approaches.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex customer problems into precise, actionable framing.
  • An ownership mindset and a high bar for product quality. You do what it takes to solve user problems and care deeply about the details of the experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building fraud prevention, risk, security, or ML powered products.
  • Experience developing machine learning powered products and evaluating trade-offs between detection effectiveness and customer friction.
  • Experience building tools for fraud analysts or risk teams, or developer products that support real-time decisions.
  • Software engineering, data science, or similar technical experience.

title: Program Manager, Professional Services
description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Professional Services (ProServ) team helps businesses around the world design, implement, and optimise their Stripe integrations. As we scale our global delivery capability, we are building a structured portfolio of service offerings that define the scope, methodology, resourcing, and commercial terms of how we engage with our users.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager (Professional Services) to own the portfolio of offerings end-to-end. The role sits at the intersection of services strategy, commercial design, and delivery operations. You will be the person who determines whether our offerings are well-designed, effectively sold, and profitably delivered and you will take action to refine the portfolio as needed. 

This is not a traditional Product Manager role, but it demands the same rigour. Your "product" is the service itself: its scope, its pricing, its methodology, and its performance. You will work closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, and Stripe's Product organisation to ensure that every offering in our portfolio is fit for purpose and continuously improving.

What You'll Do

Own the offering portfolio for Professional Services 

  • Maintain and govern ProServ’s offering portfolio including scope, hours, pricing, and resource plans for each offering. Our portfolio includes offerings designed  for all user segments from start-ups to enterprises
  • Manage the full offering lifecycle: design, build, launch, iterate, and deprecate offerings based on market need, delivery performance, and product roadmap changes
  • Ensure the portfolio stays current as Stripe launches new products 
  • Design and implement a governance framework for the portfolio of offerings

Drive offering performance analytics

  • Define and track the offering KPIs: attach rate, average scope deviation, planned vs. actual burn rate, gross margin per offering, and customer satisfaction 
  • Run regular performance reviews and present findings to ProServ leadership with clear recommendations

Refine and Improve Offering Design

  • Analyse delivery burn data to identify offerings that are systematically over- or under-scoped, and propose refinements 
  • Conduct structured retrospectives with Delivery Leads after engagement close to capture insights and feedback
  • Serve as the structured feedback loop between Delivery (what is hard to deliver), Sales (what is hard to sell), and Finance (what is margin-accretive), synthesising those inputs into offering design decisions

Who You Are

Required

  • 4+ years of Professional Services or consulting delivery experience
  • Demonstrable experience shaping or owning a service offering
  • Commercial literacy 
  • Strong analytical skills 
  • Excellent written communication 
  • Product Management training or experience
  • The ability to apply product thinking (hypothesis, prototype, measure, iterate) to service design

Preferred

  • Familiarity with Certinia and/or Salesforce
  • Exposure to partner and SI ecosystem dynamics

title: Director, Revenue Operations
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

Brex is hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to own the operating model for our New Business (AE and SDR) motions. You will report into the Head of Revenue Operations as a strategic leader. This role sets the coverage model, incentive architecture, and operating cadence for the teams you support, and is accountable for their overall performance. You'll manage a team of RevOps managers and individual contributors, and be the decision maker on tradeoffs between speed, rigor, and scale across your domain. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between executive-level narratives and the underlying mechanics that drive performance and coach their team to do the same.

Where You'll Work 

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Be a trusted business partner to the SVP Sales in owning and improving the strategies, coverage models, operating rhythms, efficiency, and incentive compensation structure to drive revenue growth
  • Lead initiatives with enablement, data, finance, systems, marketing, operations, and other revenue operations team members to support your business partners and implement improvements
  • Own and improve upon cadences for forecasting, pipeline, capacity planning, rep productivity, territory carving, quota setting, and incentive design
  • Lead and develop a team of 6+ supporting New Business Account Executives and Sales Development Representatives Organization
  • Present to senior leaders on business strategy, segment performance, and analytical deep dives
  • Drive the annual planning process for the GTM teams you support, working closely with business partners, finance, and other teams to set the strategy, align incentives, and ensure operational excellence
  • Identify and prioritize efficiency improvements within the Rev Ops org, including processes, reporting, and automation leveraging AI or other tools.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales strategy, or sales operations with at least 2+ years managing managers; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company
  • A passion for coaching and developing a team with varying levels of experience
  • Comprehensive understanding of sales funnels, processes, and methodologies in a scaled revenue organization, including with partners
  • Demonstrated success operating in a complex cross functional environment to deliver impactful outcomes
  • Direct experience owning incentive compensation design and coverage models for AE and SDR organizations at scale
  • Strong problem solving skills and collaborative approach to solutioning within and outside of Rev Ops
  • Ability to influence with or without authority, strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
  • Extensive experience with Salesforce and other GTM systems, including examples of AI-driven efficiency improvements
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to quickly interpret data and quickly understand complex models
  • Strong attention to detail including modeling, communication, and documentation

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $258,000 - $322,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

  • Lead cross-functional projects and reporting that drive performance improvement, visibility, and automation throughout financial services

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Ability to set goals and financial plans, and effectively influence leaders across Stripe
  • Exposure to audit, accounting, and risk reviews at a large public accounting firm
  • 12–15+ years of relevant public accounting and industry experience
  • Led accounting teams in a multi-location environment with exposure to multicultural and dynamic business settings
  • Com and M.Com in Accounting or Finance (Chartered Accountant or CPA strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding and hands-on experience working in US GAAP
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong knowledge of Excel and experience working with large data sets

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong operational background including new process launch and service delivery in a high-growth technology company
  • Experience with written and verbal communications for both technical and non-technical audiences at the senior leadership level
